description: This file contains type definitions, context derivation functions, and conversion utilities for message hook contexts in a messaging system, specifically for inbound and outbound message processing within a plugin architecture.

methods.name: deriveInboundMessageHookContext
methods.description: Constructs a canonical inbound message context from a finalized message context, applying overrides if provided.

methods.name: buildCanonicalSentMessageHookContext
methods.description: Creates a canonical sent message context with specified parameters.

methods.name: toPluginMessageContext
methods.description: Converts a canonical message context into a plugin message context.

methods.name: toPluginInboundClaimContext
methods.description: Generates a plugin inbound claim context from a canonical inbound message context.

methods.name: toPluginInboundClaimEvent
methods.description: Creates a plugin inbound claim event from a canonical inbound message context, with optional extras.

methods.name: toPluginMessageReceivedEvent
methods.description: Converts a canonical inbound message context into a plugin message received event.

methods.name: toPluginMessageSentEvent
methods.description: Converts a canonical sent message context into a plugin message sent event.

methods.name: toInternalMessageReceivedContext
methods.description: Transforms a canonical inbound message into an internal message received context.

methods.name: toInternalMessageTranscribedContext
methods.description: Transforms a canonical inbound message into a transcribed message context, including configuration.

methods.name: toInternalMessagePreprocessedContext
methods.description: Transforms a canonical inbound message into a preprocessed message context, including configuration.

methods.name: toInternalMessageSentContext
methods.description: Transforms a canonical sent message into an internal message sent context.
